# Explicit finite-qudit autonomous source and invariant algebra

Reconciled proof, 2026-11-01 17:45 UTC. Parent supplied this microscopic apparatus architecture. This file fixes its Hilbert space, generator, cache interface, conditional response bound and resource limitations. No external access used.

## 1. Actual Hilbert space: dimension 8w+6

For a check S=P_w...P_1 of weight w, with P_j acting on distinct data qubits, use ONE apparatus qudit with orthonormal states:
* |idle,c>, c in {+1,-1}: 2 states;
* |g_j,b,c>, |e_j,b,c>, j=1,...,w, b in {0,1}, c in {+1,-1}: 8w states;
* |f,b,c>, b in {0,1}, c in {+1,-1}: 4 states.
Total dimension d=2+8w+4=8w+6. The binary probe exists as an internal multiplicity only in active states; c is the stored cache sign in EVERY state. This is a finite multilevel qudit, NOT a qubit rail or a Fock-space single-excitation sector. Every physical basis state is a legitimate idle, live-stage or final-readout state.

Define Z_cache by Z_cache|state,c>=c|state,c> across the entire qudit. Define A=I-Pi_idle as the active projector. For fixed phase and c, |phase,s_X,c> denotes (|phase,0,c>+s|phase,1,c>)/sqrt(2).

## 2. Time-independent local generator

For each factor j set
 H_j=g sum_(b,c) [|e_j,b,c><g_j,b,c| tensor P_j^b + h.c.].
This is an apparatus-qudit/data-qubit TWO-body Hamiltonian. Its b=0 component is an onsite apparatus transition; its b=1 component is coupled to one data Pauli. There is no full-S controlled jump.

Preparation, with p_+=1-p and p_-=p, is onsite:
 L_(prep,sigma,c)=sqrt(r p_sigma)|g_1,sigma_X,c><idle,c|.
It keeps the cache and prepares the probe with finite polarization 1-2p. Summing Kraus hazards gives
 sum_(sigma,c) L†L=r Pi_idle.
The input cache may be dephased by the resolved c channels; this is allowed and does not change cache-diagonal observables.

Let next_j be g_(j+1) if j<w and f if j=w. Coherence-preserving forward decay is onsite:
 L_(j,c)=sqrt(gamma) sum_b |next_j,b,c><e_j,b,c|.
Its hazard is gamma Pi_(e_j,c). The SAME channel must carry both b amplitudes coherently. Separate which-b-resolved decay channels are a different, noisy device.

Final readout and cache overwrite is also onsite:
 L_(read,s,c)=sqrt(gamma)|idle,s><f,s_X,c|,
with s in {+1,-1}. Then
 sum_(s,c) L†L=gamma Pi_f.
Consequently final response has exactly exponential waiting time of mean 1/gamma, for EVERY final probe/cache state.

# Uniform conditional completion of a coherently driven two-body stage

Reconciled derivation, 2026-11-01 17:32 UTC. Parent supplied the apparatus-ground/excited microscopic proposal. This note proves its conditional stage-completion bound; it does not assume independent clocks or classical neighbor states. No external sources accessed.

## 1. Precise model and admissible environment

Restrict the target apparatus to one live phase with ground g and excited e (each carrying its probe/cache internal multiplicity). Its Hamiltonian is
 H_drive=g(|e><g| tensor U + |g><e| tensor U†),
where U is unitary on the carried probe and the indicated data qubit. For the parent's controlled-Pauli factor, U=sum_b |b><b| tensor P^b. The target completion channel satisfies L_out†L_out=gamma |e><e| tensor I and transfers e coherently to the next ground phase.

All remaining ideal dynamics acts on the environment and preserves this target stage before its completion. Let H_env denote its Hamiltonian, possibly time dependent and of arbitrarily large total norm. Require ONLY
 ||U† H_env U-H_env|| <= B
uniformly in time, after excluding target completion. A sufficient physical condition is bounded total strength of terms incident on the data/probe support of U; all disjoint terms cancel in this difference. For neighboring apparatus Hamiltonians with bounded degree and strength g_q, B<=2 sum_(incident q) ||H_q|| plus any other incident controls.

Other apparatus decay/reset/readout channels act on other apparatus only and commute with U. They may be retained by unitary dilation into an environment: their potentially large bath couplings then cancel from the same commutator. This does NOT justify omitting a data-noise bath or any bath coupling that fails to commute with U. Such local noise is excluded from this ideal bound or must be separately charged. No finite global environment norm is assumed.

## 2. Gauge and exact no-completion equations

Gauge the excited block by U, so the drive becomes g X between g/e. The environment Hamiltonian becomes a common H_env plus an excited-block difference D, with ||D||<=B. Go into the common environment interaction frame. Purify any initial mixed apparatus/environment state; write its no-target-completion amplitude as (a(t),b(t)). Then exactly
 a'(t)=-i g b(t),
 b'(t)=-i g a(t)-i D(t)b(t)-(gamma/2)b(t),
where D(t) is Hermitian and ||D(t)||<=B.

## 1. Explicit physical/instrument assumptions

For target check s and its at most Delta overlapping neighbors:
1. Each finite apparatus has a binary active label, conserved by its coherent stage Hamiltonians. A start pump can act only while idle, with rate r and a TP preparation map. Completion/readout is the only active->idle exit. All phase states are legitimate apparatus states; arbitrary initial partial phases are allowed.
2. Every active cycle, from ANY initial active stage and arbitrary joint quantum state/history, has survival bound
   P(active cycle not completed by t | past) <= S(t),
   where S is nonincreasing, bounded by 1, has an exponential tail, and tau=integral_0^infinity S(t)dt<infinity. Use a common envelope for freshly started and initially partial cycles. TWO_BODY_STAGE_COMPLETION_OBSERVABILITY.md supplies such an envelope for finitely many driven stages, once actual preparation/readout response stages are included.
3. Source evolution preserves every dressed true stabilizer. Cache s changes only on its completed readout, not during intermediate readout circuitry. A fully prepared, collision-free cycle has a correct QND cache overwrite as a CP-instrument identity. Finite preparation impurity has a convex bad-preparation branch of probability <=p; optional stochastic readout error may be included in p. No arbitrary coherent detector fault is silently replaced by p.
4. Start pumps are local channels with bounded attempt intensity r. Their Poisson attempt representations are independent. The quantum states, completion times and successful births need NOT be independent.

The claim below is for this ideal source plus the stated finite impurity. Other local physical noise remains separately priced.

The target observable e_s=(I-Z_cache,s Sbar_s)/2 is diagonal in apparatus active labels and in the classical cache.
